source_content:
Alderfen Microfabrication Centre

The Alderfen Institute of Materials Engineering operates this cleanroom and microfabrication platform at its Riverside Research Campus in Rochester, New York, United States.

The lithography bay is maintained to ISO 14644-1 Class 5, while general process areas are maintained to ISO 14644-1 Class 6.

Operating conditions are 21 ± 1 °C, relative humidity of 40–50%, and a pressure differential of +12 Pa relative to the adjacent corridor.

Services

Available services include photolithography, thin-film deposition, wet chemical processing, and process development support.

The centre serves academic researchers, graduate students, and early-stage materials companies.

Equipment

Tools include mask aligners, an electron-beam evaporator, a thermal evaporator, and wet-process benches.

Brackenridge NanoProcess Laboratory

The Brackenridge Centre for Applied Devices hosts the NanoProcess Laboratory in the Foundry Building at its Southbank campus in Sheffield, England, United Kingdom.

The laboratory reports ISO 14644-1 Class 7 conditions in the main process suite and Class 8 in the gowning and support area.

The process suite operates at 20–22 °C and 35–55% relative humidity. It is held at +8 Pa relative to the surrounding corridor.

What we offer

Services include photolithography, reactive-ion etching, sputter deposition, wafer dicing, and introductory cleanroom training.

Access is available to university research groups, postgraduate students, and small technology businesses by arrangement.

Tools

Available equipment includes a mask aligner, a reactive-ion etcher, a magnetron sputtering system, a wafer dicing saw, and a stylus profilometer.
